pages.text: Dry Ice is a very cold reactor coolant. It can be found underground in sufficiently cold biomes.
Default 1.12.2 worldgen: Y 1–64, 9 attempts/chunk, vein size 17, biome temperature at most 0.15. These values are configurable.

pages.title: 2 Packed Ice → Dry Ice$(br)10,000 FE.$(br2)Packed Ice replaces modern Blue Ice for Minecraft 1.12.2.
